column1: Expected credit losses on loans and advances in the consolidated financial statements

The disclosure associated with credit risk is set out in the consolidated financial statements in the following
notes:
• Note 3 (f) (iii) – Material accounting policies, Impairment on financial assets (page 157 – 161).
• Note 4(a) – Financial risk management, Credit risk (page 174 – 210).
• Note 20(b) – Impairment loss on loans and advances and other financial assets at amortised costs (page 246).
